answer: Surprise parallel liveness: at a beacon-chosen second each epoch, every key whose IP or funding signal echoes another's gets the same fresh prompt at once and must return a distinct, coherent 200-character reply within 4 seconds or lose that epoch's pay. An honest agent serves one reply. An operator running 50 keys on a thin ledge of shared hardware must keep 50 model instances warm all day, since the second is unknown: cost tracks peak concurrency x n, not average compute.
